headline: Busiest Saturday in eight weeks; flat CPC turned last week's loss into $4,334
commentary:
### The day
- Saturday flipped from red to **$4,334 NP**, on a thin 12.6% margin.
  - NP: $4,334 v -$1,299 last Sat
  - NM: 12.6% v 17.9% MTD
- Most leads we've had on a Saturday in two months.
  - Processed: 2,162 v 1,710 Saturday mean
  - NP: $4,334 v $3,745 Saturday mean
- November stays comfortably ahead of October over the same days.
  - MTD NP: $54,515 v $34,421
  - MTD NM: 17.9% v 13.0%
### What drove it
- Volume did the work. Search clicks up 38%, CPC unchanged.
  - Clicks: 2,841 v 2,054 last Sat
  - CPC: $10.24 v $10.21
- The extra spend landed in Spanish, payday alternative and bad credit.
  - es_search: $1,876 v $555 last Sat
  - payday_alternative: $5,900 v $4,345
  - bad_credit: $2,699 v $1,866
- Lead value was ordinary, not special; last Saturday was the odd one.
  - EPL: $15.91 v $16.05 Saturday mean
  - Search EPL: $23.83 v $18.78 last Sat
- **albert.com retreated across almost every campaign** and we took a little share.
  - albert account IS: 34.6% v 43.0%
  - Our IS: 10.7% v 10.1%
### Tests
| Test | Set-up | Spend 07/11 | Spend wk ago | Change |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| personal | tROAS, off seasonality | $218 | $79.39 | — |
| competitor | tROAS, off seasonality | $887 | $406 | — |
| speed | bid target walked down | $1,434 | $606 | — |
| scavengers | low-CPC sweeper pair | $1,635 | $1,023 | — |
- Speed is being walked down, yet it found twice the clicks.
  - Clicks: 96 v 44 last Sat
  - CPC: $14.94 v $13.78
- Scavengers kept doing their job at pennies next to core CPCs.
  - competitor_scavenger CPC: $3.08 v $3.17
  - amount_scavenger: $379 spend, 89 clicks
watch: Saturday margin at 12.6% against 17.9% MTD — whether weekend NM keeps thinning as volume builds.
Whether albert.com stays out of the auction; if they return, the $10.24 CPC won't hold.
